//===== NEED Phase 0.36 - identity severity probe + @p36 ====================
//= TEST ONLY. GENERATED by p36_runtime.py. Registers nothing, changes nothing.
//= Scanner/audit phase: no C++ change, no script change, no rebuild.
//=
//= Each probe below makes a lookup FAIL on purpose, to demonstrate the severity
//= recorded in phase36_identity_sink_inventory.csv. The ShowError lines these
//= produce are DELIBERATE and are counted separately in the runtime results.
//============================================================================

-	script	NEED Phase36 Verify	-1,{
	end;

OnInit:
	debugmes "[P36] ---- severity probe start ----";

	// ---------- SCRIPT_ABORT: instance_npcname (script.cpp:22616-22618) ----------
	donpcevent "NEED Phase36 Verify::OnAbortA";
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] instance_npcname bad key = SCRIPT_ABORT confirmed if the UNEXPECTED line above is absent";

	// ---------- SCRIPT_ABORT: callfunc (script.cpp:5487-5489) ----------
	donpcevent "NEED Phase36 Verify::OnAbortB";
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] callfunc bad key = SCRIPT_ABORT confirmed if the UNEXPECTED line above is absent";

	// ---------- ERROR_LOG_ONLY: enablenpc/disablenpc (script.cpp:12591-12594) ----------
	disablenpc "P36 NO SUCH NPC";
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] disablenpc bad key = ERROR_LOG_ONLY, execution CONTINUED";

	// ---------- NO_OP: getnpcid (script.cpp:9004) ----------
	.@id = getnpcid(0, "P36 NO SUCH NPC");
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] getnpcid bad key = NO_OP, returned " + .@id + " and execution CONTINUED";

	// ---------- ERROR_LOG_ONLY: donpcevent (script.cpp:11748/11751) ----------
	donpcevent "P36 NO SUCH NPC::OnNope";
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] donpcevent bad key = ERROR_LOG_ONLY, execution CONTINUED";

	// ---------- FALLBACK: instance_mapname (script.cpp:22644) ----------
	.@mn$ = instance_mapname("no_such_map");
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] instance_mapname bad key = FALLBACK, returned \"" + .@mn$ + "\" and execution CONTINUED";

	// ---------- positive control: a real key resolves through npc_name2id ----------
	.@ok = getnpcid(0, "NEED Phase36 Verify");
	if ( .@ok != 0 )
		debugmes "[P36][SEV] positive control: a REAL key resolves through npc_name2id (id=" + .@ok + ")";
	else
		debugmes "[P36][SEV][UNEXPECTED] positive control FAILED - the probe itself is wrong";

	debugmes "[P36] ---- severity probe done ----";
	bindatcmd "p36", "NEED Phase36 Verify::OnAtP36", 99, 99;
	end;

OnAbortA:
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] OnAbortA: calling instance_npcname with a key that does not exist";
	.@x$ = instance_npcname("P36 NO SUCH NPC");
	debugmes "[P36][SEV][UNEXPECTED] OnAbortA continued PAST instance_npcname - not an abort";
	end;

OnAbortB:
	debugmes "[P36][SEV] OnAbortB: calling callfunc with a function that does not exist";
	callfunc "F_P36_NO_SUCH_FUNCTION";
	debugmes "[P36][SEV][UNEXPECTED] OnAbortB continued PAST callfunc - not an abort";
	end;

OnAtP36:
	dispbottom "[P36] identity-argument audit: display and lookup are separate concerns.";
	dispbottom "[P36] Lookup identity is ALWAYS the canonical server key, on every session.";
	.@a = getnpcid(0, "NEED Phase36 Verify");
	dispbottom "[P36] npc_name2id on a real key -> " + ( .@a != 0 ? "resolves" : "MISSING" );
	.@b = getnpcid(0, "P36 NO SUCH NPC");
	dispbottom "[P36] npc_name2id on a bogus key -> " + ( .@b == 0 ? "0, as documented" : "UNEXPECTED" );
	dispbottom "[P36] need_lang=" + getneedlang() + " - the identity above did not depend on it.";
	end;
}
